verdict.rationale: Tailscale documents an official 'Tailscale skill' that lets a coding agent work with Tailscale configuration and code, so a user can drive configuration through natural-language instructions to an agent. This is a first-party capability, but the docs give it only a one-line mention, and it relies on an external agent rather than a native natural-language interface. llms.txt and the Aperture agent gateway are adjacent features that don't add to this story. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface in the product or admin console, documented scope of which operations the skill can perform, and hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.
